sides.name: spec-static
sides.command: { go vet ./...; if command -v openlore >/dev/null 2>&1; then openlore check-spec-drift --failOn=warning; fi; if command -v staticcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then staticcheck ./...; fi; }
sides.parity_focus: go vet, openlore spec drift, and staticcheck

sides.name: frontend
sides.command: cd web && ([ -d node_modules ] || npm install) && timeout 10m npm run build
sides.parity_focus: Svelte dashboard build only (CLIProxyAPI has no frontend)

sides.name: routing
sides.parity_focus: routing, connection selection, proxy pool, and API handler behavior vs CLIProxyAPI internal/api and OmniRoute routing/policy modules

sides.name: executor
sides.parity_focus: executor and translator behavior, especially Codex/Claude Code request/response handling vs CLIProxyAPI internal/executor and internal/translator

sides.name: provider
sides.parity_focus: provider config, quota, and network handling vs CLIProxyAPI provider/quota and OmniRoute quota cache / policy engine

sides.name: auth
sides.parity_focus: auth and signature/token flows vs CLIProxyAPI internal/auth and internal/signature

sides.name: data
sides.parity_focus: data layer, cache, background jobs, logging, and usage tracking vs CLIProxyAPI internal/store/cache/logging and OmniRoute usage tracking

references.name: OmniRoute
references.note: Use only for proven, production-tested patterns. Do not copy its full 231-provider catalog or dashboard-only features.

references.name: 9router
references.note: Use as a lightweight reference for custom provider behavior, CLI patterns, and modular routing ideas. Compare only current side.
